opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from the humanities or social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research organisation; British citizens and EEA nationals; any nationality with a doctorate from a UK university; must be early‑career postdoctoral researchers and not hold a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year award for early‑career researchers to undertake an independent research project leading to a publishable piece of work.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK higher‑education institution or independent research organisation; must be ordinarily resident in the UK; must be working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK‑based researchers to develop quantitative, data‑science, digital humanities or language skills through projects of up to 12 months, up to £10 k.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit position, who have teaching/admin duties; lead applicant must be UK‑based; co‑applicant must be from a different Academy remit.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for interdisciplinary research across humanities, social sciences, natural sciences and engineering to address societal challenges, up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any UK‑based researcher across career stages; must have prior public‑engagement experience; cannot have previously received this award.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects with GLAM or performing‑arts partners, up to £8 k.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences (post‑doctoral level or above) with international co‑applicants; must demonstrate genuine interdisciplinary collaboration across SHAPE or STEM.
opportunities.summary: 24‑month interdisciplinary projects on mobilities, involving UK researchers and international partners, up to £300 k.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ and mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; must be ordinarily resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships hosted at DGAP Berlin, up to £150 k, to develop policy‑relevant analysis and networks.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers affiliated with a UK or German research institution.
opportunities.summary: Attendance at a three‑day symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, with seed funding for collaborative projects.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs of applicants or award‑holders (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support). Applications reviewed monthly.
